# WebDAV

![CRAN_Status_Badge](https://www.r-pkg.org/badges/version/webdav)  
![CRAN Downloads](https://cranlogs.r-pkg.org/badges/grand-total/webdav)
  ![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-darkviolet.svg) 
![Devel
Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/devel%20version-0.3.0-blue.svg)

WebDAV (*Web Distributed Authoring and Versioning*) is an extension of
the HTTP protocol that allows users to collaboratively edit and manage
files stored on remote web servers. It provides a framework for users to
create, delete, copy, move, and download files.

### Examples of WebDAV Servers

Some platforms that implement WebDAV are:

1.  **OwnCloud**: A popular open-source platform for storing and sharing
    files, commonly used by organizations.
2.  **NextCloud**: A fork of OwnCloud that focuses on user-friendly
    interfaces and collaborative file-sharing features.
3.  **mod_dav** for Apache HTTP servers: Adds WebDAV support to the
    Apache web server.
4.  **Microsoft SharePoint**: Uses WebDAV for file management over the
    web.

### Installation

Install the released version from CRAN:

``` r

install.packages("webdav")
```

Or the development version from GitHub:

``` r

# install.packages("remotes")
remotes::install_github("StrategicProjects/webdav")
```

### Functions

| Function | WebDAV method | Description |
|----|----|----|
| [`webdav_create_request()`](https://strategicprojects.github.io/webdav/reference/webdav_create_request.md) | — | Build an authenticated `httr2` request for the server |
| [`webdav_list_files()`](https://strategicprojects.github.io/webdav/reference/webdav_list_files.md) | PROPFIND | List files and folders as a tibble |
| [`webdav_upload_file()`](https://strategicprojects.github.io/webdav/reference/webdav_upload_file.md) | PUT | Upload a local file (streamed from disk) |
| [`webdav_download_file()`](https://strategicprojects.github.io/webdav/reference/webdav_download_file.md) | GET | Download a file (streamed to disk) |
| [`webdav_create_directory()`](https://strategicprojects.github.io/webdav/reference/webdav_create_directory.md) | MKCOL | Create a collection (directory) |
| [`webdav_copy_file()`](https://strategicprojects.github.io/webdav/reference/webdav_copy_file.md) | COPY | Copy a resource |
| [`webdav_move_file()`](https://strategicprojects.github.io/webdav/reference/webdav_move_file.md) | MOVE | Move or rename a resource |
| [`webdav_delete_resource()`](https://strategicprojects.github.io/webdav/reference/webdav_delete_resource.md) | DELETE | Delete a file or directory |

### Quick start

Credentials default to the `WEBDAV_USERNAME` and `WEBDAV_PASSWORD`
environment variables (see
[`vignette("env_variables")`](https://strategicprojects.github.io/webdav/articles/env_variables.md)):

``` r

library(webdav)

base_url <- "https://cloud.example.com/remote.php/dav/files/user"

# List what's there
webdav_list_files(base_url, folder_path = "Documents")

# Upload, rename, download, clean up
webdav_upload_file(base_url, local_path = "report.pdf", server_path = "Documents")
webdav_move_file(base_url,
                 from_path = "Documents/report.pdf",
                 to_path = "Documents/report-2026.pdf")
webdav_download_file(base_url,
                     file_path = "Documents/report-2026.pdf",
                     destination_path = tempdir())
webdav_delete_resource(base_url, resource_path = "Documents/report-2026.pdf")
```

Invalid arguments raise an error; network or server failures issue a
warning and return `FALSE` (`NULL` for
[`webdav_list_files()`](https://strategicprojects.github.io/webdav/reference/webdav_list_files.md)),
so scripts can test the return value instead of wrapping calls in
[`tryCatch()`](https://rdrr.io/r/base/conditions.html).

# Package index

## All functions

- [`handle_response()`](https://strategicprojects.github.io/webdav/reference/handle_response.md)
  : Handle HTTP response from Server
- [`webdav_copy_file()`](https://strategicprojects.github.io/webdav/reference/webdav_copy_file.md)
  : Copy a resource on the WebDAV server
- [`webdav_create_directory()`](https://strategicprojects.github.io/webdav/reference/webdav_create_directory.md)
  : Create a collection (directory) on a WebDAV server
- [`webdav_create_request()`](https://strategicprojects.github.io/webdav/reference/webdav_create_request.md)
  : Create a request for the WebDAV server
- [`webdav_delete_resource()`](https://strategicprojects.github.io/webdav/reference/webdav_delete_resource.md)
  : Delete a file or directory from the WebDAV server
- [`webdav_download_file()`](https://strategicprojects.github.io/webdav/reference/webdav_download_file.md)
  : Download a file from the WebDAV server
- [`webdav_list_files()`](https://strategicprojects.github.io/webdav/reference/webdav_list_files.md)
  : List files from a specific folder on WebDAV server
- [`webdav_move_file()`](https://strategicprojects.github.io/webdav/reference/webdav_move_file.md)
  : Move or rename a resource on the WebDAV server
- [`webdav_upload_file()`](https://strategicprojects.github.io/webdav/reference/webdav_upload_file.md)
  : Upload a file to the WebDAV server
